validation_scope: complete actual source and packaged payload in mocked Roblox and HTTP environment

ai_behavior.kind: local rule-based controller; no LLM or external AI service
ai_behavior.place_metadata: game.Name and game.PlaceId displayed; not semantic understanding of a game's rules
ai_behavior.equipment_detection: equipped Tool WeaponType attribute or name keywords; Auto, Ranged and Melee choices
ai_behavior.unknown_equipment: does not attack or move in Auto; profile can be selected explicitly
ai_behavior.targeting: live visible on-screen enemy Head inside AI FOV and maximum distance
ai_behavior.friendly_targets: always excluded independently of ESP teammate visibility
ai_behavior.attack: ordinary Tool:Activate and Tool:Deactivate; after two aligned render frames; bounded cadence
ai_behavior.movement: optional Humanoid:Move on a clear straight line of sight; default off; no pathfinding
ai_behavior.manual_settings: manual aim view, method and other preferences remain unchanged
ai_behavior.restart: AI itself always off on script execution; AI preferences persist
ai_behavior.pause: menu opening releases attack and owned movement; closing can resume an armed AI
ai_behavior.stop: manual movement, mouse input, chat focus, window blur, character loss, camera loss, access loss or unload
ai_behavior.release_retry: failed Tool release retries after render unbinding; per-activation identity protects a newer pulse

regression_coverage: equipped ranged Tool recognition and bounded primary activation
attack cadence, teammate and line-of-sight filtering
manual WASD, mouse movement, mouse buttons, chat and focus stop
unknown, backpack, disabled and missing-handle Tool behavior
manual first-person-only setting does not block third-person AI
unlocked cursor alignment while manual Center preference is preserved
transient release failure after cleanup and stale timer on a fresh same-Tool activation
10-stud maximum excludes a target at 15 and permits it only after it enters range
live_roblox: not tested; no connected Studio session
compatibility_limits: No guarantee of compatibility with every game or custom weapon input system
No inferred mouse-button mappings or guessed game RemoteEvent calls
No general map, objectives or mission understanding
No anticheat bypass or guaranteed hit/kill outcome
